source: Google Sheet: Forged and Sent Workout Library (1M-DqwYO3NNPdksY3rubN-PBkoHeWw2BqDoLpQzjgX7c)
restDayRule: Place templateDay 7 on the user's chosen weekday and count forward, so templateDay 1 is the day after the rest day. Plan day 1 starts on the first date that is the day after the rest day. Optional (templateDay 6) is shown only when the user turns on the 4th training day.
notes: day = plan day 1-365. templateDay = ((day-1) mod 7)+1. Day 365 is templateDay 1 of week 53. exercises are [generic movement, prescription]; resolve the movement through movements.json byEquipment[setup]. theme details (warmup, finisher, notes) are in workout-themes.json keyed 'Program|templateDay'.
sessionDesign: Core days (templateDay 1, 3, 5) are full-body sessions in Forged and Built, and full-body power sessions in Warrior (days 1 and 3). Engine and Warrior day 5 stay conditioning circuits. Optional day 6 is a lighter full-body or conditioning session. Strength and power days end with an arm superset (see armSupersetDesign).
movementsNote: movements.json is the full exercise library for custom plans. Some movements are not used in any scheduled day and exist only as custom-plan options. Each has a 'video' object {url, channel, views}, except Rest Day.
warmupDesign: Each Core and Optional day has a 'warmup' list of [movement, prescription] pairs: cardio primer, mobility, activation, and a bodyweight primer matched to the day's main pattern. No warm-up movement needs a barbell or dumbbells. Pairs resolve through movements.json like exercises. Recovery and Rest days have an empty list and use the theme warmup text. For Core/Optional days the theme 'warmup' text is only a generic fallback line.
alternatesDesign: alternates.json maps movement -> reason -> up to 4 swap movements (nearest first). Reasons: No Barbell, No Bench, No Pull-Up Bar, No Cable or Machine, Knee, Hip, Low Back, Shoulder, Elbow or Wrist, Low Impact, Any Discomfort. Every alternate is a movements.json entry; resolve the display name through byEquipment for the user's setup. Not medical advice.
recoveryDesign: Recovery days (templateDay 2 and 4) need no equipment in every setup: an easy walk or jog plus floor, wall and bodyweight mobility. Their movements resolve to the same equipment-free exercise in all four setups.
coachingDesign: Day-level warm-up, finisher and coaching notes are written for a first-time gym goer in a personal trainer voice (purpose, RPE and RIR explained, rest times, progression, deload, soreness, scaling). Each movement also has a long-form howTo (Setup, Move, Watch for, Tip) next to its short cue. General coaching, not medical advice. Each day also has a separate purpose field explaining what the day is for.
armSupersetDesign: Every strength and power day, plus the Engine/Pulse strength circuit day, ends with a two-exercise arm superset (biceps curl A1, triceps A2) that adds about 7 minutes (session length 52). The day object carries a superset field with the indices of the two exercises in the exercises list. Pairings rotate by template day and by 4-week block. Week 4 deload uses 2 rounds. Recovery, rest, interval, metabolic and combat days have no arm superset.
